product.objective: Surface the players our model thinks are most likely to score a touchdown, with honest uncertainty.

reason: 8 model candidates, but no card: the sportsbooks are not offering anytime-touchdown markets for these games and preseason playing time is unknown, so no player's role is established. A watchlist is something to look at — it is not a card, carries no return, and is not an instruction to bet.
